children: Cintas reported fiscal 2027 first-quarter results for the three months ended August 31, 2026, with revenue of $3.01 billion, up 10.9% year-over-year, and net income of $551.7 million. Adjusted diluted EPS (excluding UniFirst transaction expenses) was $1.39, a 15.8% increase from the prior year, and the company raised its full-year fiscal 2027 revenue and adjusted diluted EPS guidance. Cintas said organic revenue growth for the quarter was 8.9% and noted record revenue and record operating margin.
Total revenue: $3,013,981 (Q1 FY2027) vs. $2,718,122 (Q1 FY2026), increase of 10.9%.
Gross profit: $1,553,543; total gross margin 51.5% for Q1 FY2027 (up from 50.3% prior year).
Operating income: $711,887 for Q1 FY2027 (15.2% increase vs. $617,859 prior year); operating margin 23.6% of revenue.
Net income: $551,711 for Q1 FY2027 vs. $491,140 prior year (12.3% increase).
Adjusted diluted EPS: $1.39 for Q1 FY2027 (excluding $14.4 million UniFirst transaction expenses; diluted EPS reported $1.36 vs. $1.20 prior year).
Organic revenue growth of 8.9% for the quarter after adjusting for acquisitions, FX and workday differences; workday-adjusted growth reported at 9.2%.
Uniform rental and facility services remained the largest segment with revenue of $2,294,736 for the quarter and a gross margin of 50.8% in the segment.
First Aid and Safety Services revenue was $388,517, contributing operating income of $99,542 for the quarter, reflecting continued demand in safety services.
Free cash flow for the quarter was $464,799 (net cash provided by operations $572,331 less capital expenditures $107,532).
Company paid quarterly dividends ($208.8 million aggregate on Sept 15, 2026) and repurchased $544.7 million of common stock through Sept 22, 2026 under share buyback programs.
